a.text: There is a legend in Lungmen.
The dark slums are a turbulent place where different factions cross paths. There, one must tread extremely carefully, lest one find oneself swept away by the roiling waves.
Yet there is one man who stands at the pinnacle, above all these different factions, and maintains order from the shadows. It could even be said that the entire slums move to his will alone.
There are many rumors about him, though few have actually seen him in person.
During his day-to-day life, he is no different from any other local. You could walk right past him without realizing his true identity.

You will never know if the random passerby you happen to lay eyes on is one of his informants. You will also never know if, in some dark corner, he is obliterating those foolish enough to stand up to him.
He is Lungmen's shadow, the embodiment of the slums.
And there are many who believe that this is no mere legend...

steps.text: That's him? You absolutely sure? You're pulling my leg.
I've been watching him for a while now. Fits the leaked description to a T. It's gotta be him.
Man... He doesn't look like no pushover...
What do we do? Are we really jumping him?
The goods we lost are too important. We don't have a choice... What was the password again?
I remember it. It's...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Well, look at you. Business is going well. Not taking any time off for New Year's?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: There's a lot of foot traffic at night. Figured I'd make a bit of money.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Here you go, Miss. Your spicy finballs.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Whoa, that smells so great! Here's the cash.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Mmm... Delish! Just what you'd expect from a finball stall that comes highly recommended in the Great Foodie Guide!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Hold on!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: W-What's the matter?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You paid too much. Here's your change.

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: T-Thank you...

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Um... May I go now?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What, you need something else?

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: N-Not at all! See you!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Looks like I scared off another customer...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Did I say something wrong?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hohoh... You've been tending to the stall for a couple of days now. What's going on with Old Tung?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: The weather's been cold, and he says that hurts his legs, so I'm helping him out more often.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Do you know Uncle Tung, Master Lin?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: He's the finest finball chef in town. Of course I know him.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Since I'm here, I might as well give him a bit of business too. I'll have an order of finballs. Let's see how much you've learned from him.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Got it. One sec.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Four orders of finballs. Three curries and one mushroom soup.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yeah, got it. I'll start yours after I finish the last guy's order.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Ahem. I said. Four orders of finballs. Three curries and one mushroom soup.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yeah, got it. Three curries, one mushroom soup.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (What's going on?! Didn't you say that was the password?)

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (It's gotta be! You know that Feline assassin? That's what she tells him every time!)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Master, your finballs.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Very good. Here's the money.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: No need. You're Uncle Tung's friend, I can't take your money.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That won't do. Debts must be paid, and what must be done, must be done.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Isn't that right?

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (What's going on? Did that old fart just glance at us?)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (Tsk... What a pain.)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Sir...?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You still want your finballs?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: If you don't know which flavor you want, I can give you two to try out—

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: What're you getting all feisty for?!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: If we don't get the drop on him now, then when? After he wastes us?!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Now cut the crap! Let's drag him off!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Leave a message for the Lou Seois. We have their boss, and they gotta bring the goods tonight if they want him alive!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now, now, young men. Don't overdo it. There are certain rules here in Lungmen that you don't break.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Shut up, Grandpa! This is business! Sit down and eat your finballs!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Interesting.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: My head hurts...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What's this...? Where am I?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Yo, you're finally awake. Here, have some water.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Thanks—What's going on? Who are you people... and why am I tied up...?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Sorry, but we had no choice but to go to these lengths for someone of your stature. We didn't know the Lou Seois were working for you. Please forgive us.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: That said, the Lou Seois started this. They're the ones who took our goods first. Not very reasonable, don't you think?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What goods? Fins? The boat was there at the docks, and I got there first. Of course I got all the freshest fins. What makes them yours?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (Did he just say, 'the docks'? Didn't our goods get lifted at the docks?)

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (Right, I get it. 'Fins' is an euphemism. What he's saying is finders keepers. The goods belong to whoever gets their hands on them first.)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: *Cough*... Alright, you have a point.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: But there are rules in this business. We Char Sius have been dealing in this stuff the whole time. Don't you think you should at least give us a heads-up if you were going to edge into our business?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I've been running my seafood stall for years now. How come I've never seen you people around then?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (Is 'seafood stall' an euphemism too?)

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (What he's saying is he's been in this business longer than us. We got here after him.)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Right... We know that. You're known far and wide all across Lungmen. We respect someone of your stature. That's why we're taking the time to discuss this all friendly-like.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: If you want to get in on this business, we can talk, but the goods you stole are very important to us Char Sius. Please give them back, and this'll be easier on the both of us.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Known... all across Lungmen?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Um... I think you got the wrong person. Can I go now...?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Don't push it! That how you wanna play this?!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: If it weren't for the respect we have for you, we wouldn't be here talking. We Char Sius ain't just gonna let you push us around!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I really don't know what you're talking about...

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Still playing dumb, huh? Bring me the thing.

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Take a look at this picture. Ring a bell?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Is this... Waai Fu?

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Don't think we don't know. She's a hitman who works for you Lou Seois, and your bodyguard.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Late last month, she stopped by your stall for finballs. The very next day, the Lou Seois' biggest rivals got their crib trashed. They say it was a Feline with some weird kung fu skills.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: And you're saying you didn't order it?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Why did she have to pick that time of all times to play hero...?

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: And what about this one?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Madame Oni from the L.G.D.?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Looks like it's not just us. The L.G.D. has had eyes on you for a long time.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Our guys have seen that Madame Oni hanging out next to your finball shack more than once.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Now why don't you tell me why an Inspector from the L.G.D.'s Special Ops Team be interested in some finball hawker?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: This is all just a misunderstanding...

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Hmph, don't you think you can fool us with your little switcheroo.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Admit it. That dude you guys call the boss is just a decoy, and you're the real boss of the Lou Seois!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (I should probably just shut up for now.)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Nothing more to say, huh?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Alright, no more talking. Let's see how much your goons care about their boss.
Meanwhile...
Yo, Second Bro, we finally have news about the boss!
Where is he?!
The Char Sius just sent us a message. Apparently they took him hostage.
They sent us an address, and told us to bring the goods if we want the boss alive.
Dammit, I knew it was them! Get the whole gang! We're settling the score with the Char Sius tonight!
So are we bringing the goods or...?
'Course not! They think we're pushovers, huh? Get your weapons! Those punks are going down!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Thought it through yet, 'Boss'?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Your lackeys got the message already. Hand over the goods, and no one has to get hurt. Wouldn't want your pretty face getting messed up in a struggle, would you?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Why'd you send them a message? What if they actually send people here to fight you guys?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: You got balls, punk, still trying to threaten us!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: That's not what I was—*Sigh*... never mind.

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (What do we do? He's got a point. If it comes to a fight, we're way outnumbered here.)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (Well, why didn't you bring more guys then?!)

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (You're the one who wanted to keep this on the down low!)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (Well, I didn't expect him to not talk!)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (Whatever, just keep an eye on him... If you can convince him to cough up the goods, all the better. I'll go get the others.)

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: *Cough*...

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Thought it through yet, 'Boss'?

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: If you know what's good for you, you'll hand over the goods now, and we can still do this peacefully.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Mind if I ask what 'goods' we're talking about here?

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Cut the crap! Your gang beat up our guys at the port just to get your hands on them! You know what they are!

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Heh, only you freaks would try to take a dangerous job like this from us.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Did you just say 'dangerous'?

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Stop playing dumb! If you guys had the balls to snatch this job from right under the L.G.D.'s nose, you knew what you were getting into! You knew it was gonna be a big payday!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Um... It's just you and me here right now, right?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Fine, I'll tell you where they are.

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Oh? Now that's more like it. Talk.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Come closer, you never know who's listening.

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Alright, now spit it out.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Closer.

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Enough chit-chat. Just—

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Uncle Tung was right. Better to use your head than your fists.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You guys really tied me up good, huh... Sorry, I'm borrowing this knife. I'll give it back if we ever see each other again.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I don't know who you're looking for or what you want, but you've got the wrong guy. I ain't anybody's boss.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: *Sigh*... But listening's not your strong point, is it? Anyway, I'mma split here.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Ugh, my head hurts...
This is the place. Now where are the Char Sius?
Look over there. Some guy just came out of that building with a knife. I bet that's our contact with them.
Hold up, doesn't that guy look kind of familiar?
Now I remember! He's that top assassin who's always disguised as a seafood hawker! Last time he skinned twenty people alive with a scaling knife! I saw it with my own eyes!
I didn't know he was with the Char Sius! What do we do now...?
Calm down. Let's try talking to him first.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: No one came after me. Guess I lost them...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: *Sigh*... It's New Year's. I haven't even closed the stall yet. What is going on...?
Hey, you.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Huh? Me?
This the Char Sius' hideout?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (The guys from before said they're from the Char Sius, didn't they?)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yeah, that's right.

steps.name: Vicious-Looking Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Get him!

steps.name: Vicious-Looking Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Where's our boss?!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: How would I know?!

steps.name: Vicious-Looking Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Heh, I know you Char Sius got numbers, but that doesn't mean jack against us!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You got the wrong guy—

steps.name: Angry Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: He took down Second Bro in just one hit! I knew it! That's their top assassin!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Not another version of this...

steps.name: Angry Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Don't worry! We got the numbers! Even he can't take on all of us at once!

steps.name: Angry Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: With me, guys! We're saving the boss!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Well... Guess I better make a run for it first...

steps.name: Angry Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Don't let him get away! After him!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Alright, they brought their people with them.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Let's go, boys! Get 'em!

steps.name: Angry Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Heh, an ambush, huh?

steps.name: Angry Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Don't be afraid, boys! Let's show 'em who's boss!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Hand over the goods!

steps.name: Angry Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Hand over the boss!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Uh, how come you guys are fighting? Take it easy. There's no need for violence.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Uh... *Sigh*... I guess I'll go back and close the stall.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: What're these 'goods' I keep hearing about, anyway...?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Good evening, Uncle Wong.

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: Well, hello there, Jaye. What's up? I don't have any fresh fins for you at this hour.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: No, I just have a question.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Have you seen any big fights here lately?

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: Oh, don't make me laugh. There are more fights here on the docks than we have fins for sale. What kinda fight are we talking about here?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I don't mean a normal street fight. I mean like two gangs of mean-looking people fighting each other.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Eh, that's probably not the best way to describe it... Uncle, have you seen any new faces at the docks lately?

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: The docks are huge. How am I supposed to remember every single person I see?

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: *Sigh*... Now that you mention it, though, this is starting to ring a bell.

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: For a while last month, there was a group of people hauling crates here every night.

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: Normally I wouldn't give it a second thought, but all their crates were wrapped up in black. It all looked very shady.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Do you remember what those people looked like? Where did they take the crates?

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: I was busy closing up. You think I'd remember something like that? Not everyone's got a good memory like you.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (So those must be the goods the Char Sius kept talking about.)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (What are they planning...?)

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: Ai-yah, I didn't even notice, but look at those bruises. You were fighting again, weren't you?

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: Here, put some ice on it.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: You know, you seem like the honest sort, but how come you always have all these scrapes and bruises?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Uh... I didn't really mean to—

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: I've known you for a long time now. You're a good kid. You're patient, and you can't stand injustice. That's why you always end up fighting those punks.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: No, it's actually all just a mis—

steps.name: Uncle Wong
steps.text: I know your heart's in the right place, but you need to protect yourself too. If something happens, let somebody else take care of it. Don't go looking for trouble with people you shouldn't mess with. Got it?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yeah, I got it. Thanks. I have something to take care of tonight though, and I know how to handle it.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Oh, right, is it okay if I borrow your phone?

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Goddamned Char Sius. They sure put up a good fight...

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Now where is everyone...? So quick to run. Where'd they go...?
Oh, good. There's still one of you left.

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: I-It's you!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Right, it's me.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: The Char Sius' top assassin.

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Yeek!

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Please... Please don't hurt me!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I can overlook everything you just did, for now.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: But listen up. I'll only ask this once. And if I don't like your answer...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Well, you'll see.

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: I'll talk! I'll talk! I'll tell you everything that I know!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Where are the goods the Lou Seois stole from us last week?

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: I don't know!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Why did you steal them? Who's the buyer?

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Again you don't know?!

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: I really don't know!

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: I-I've only been with the gang for two months... I really don't know any of our big secrets!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Then what DO you know?!

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: It was last week! Our members stole something from the Char Sius at the port. The boss was real happy, but he went missing just a few days later.

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: We looked everywhere, but couldn't find a thing.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (So their boss really is missing.)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: And then?

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Then, we got your guys' message today. I figured there was going to be a fight, so I tagged along. Seriously, that's all I know!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (Hm... Looks like that's all I'm getting from this guy.)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: *Cough*. I'll tell you this much. Your boss? We Char Sius kidnapped him.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Go home and tell your boss. Uh... tell whoever's calling the shots without him.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'll give you one last chance to settle this peacefully. Meet us at the docks with what you stole. Midnight.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: And I'd better see some sincerity, or your boss is dead meat.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Now scram.

steps.name: Injured Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Looks like he bought it.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: It's not easy playing the villain.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Calm down. Calm down... Next up...

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: You idiot! Imbecile!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: We had the guy tied up. How'd you let him get away? Now how are we supposed to negotiate with the Lou Seois?

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: What're you yelling at me for? You brought all those guys and still couldn't catch him!

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: Why you—
I heard somebody's looking for me.

steps.name: Char Siu Members
steps.text: It's you!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yep, it's me.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Heh, I gotta hand it to you two. You've got keen eyes, being able to see through my act.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: That's right. I'm the boss of the Lou Seois.

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: I knew it... W-What do you want?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: It's very simple. The things we took from you? You can have them back. But we'll need an explanation for why you kidnapped me.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: We'll be waiting for you at the docks with the goods, tonight at midnight. I want all of the Char Sius there.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'll let you have what's yours, but I won't tolerate this disrespect.

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (What should we do? Do we still want it...?)

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: (W-Wait... He's all by himself. We managed to knock him out earlier, maybe we can...)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hold it right there!

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: T-That's the Feline hitman! It's her!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Heh, I let my guard down and got ambushed once, but did you really think I'd let it happen again?!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Sounds to me you don't know who you're dealing with.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: *Cough*...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (What do I do now?)

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: (The wall. The wall!)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: (Oh, right.)

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: She knocked the wall down... in one strike!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'll be waiting at the docks in two hours. You better show up if you know what's good for you!

steps.name: Shrewd-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: What do we do now...?

steps.name: Fierce-looking Char Siu Member
steps.text: What do you mean, what do we do? There's no running from it. We just have to go!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Wait, wait! Hold on! Why are we running so fast?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You still haven't told me what this charade's all about.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Phew... This should be far enough.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: *Sigh* To tell you the truth, I don't really know what's going on myself.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Anyway, thanks for the help. I'll treat you to some finballs next time.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: No worries. It's no big deal.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You really looked like some mafia boss just now, though. I nearly fell for it myself.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Do I really look like such a bad guy?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You're not hiding any secret identities from me, are you?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Come on, stop teasing me.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Eh, I'll head to the docks first. All of this should start to make sense come midnight.

steps.name: Char Siu Member
steps.text: Good. Right on time.

steps.name: Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Heh, I could say the same to you.

steps.name: Char Siu Member
steps.text: Where're the goods?

steps.name: Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Slow down. Where's our boss?

steps.name: Char Siu Member
steps.text: Don't make me laugh. You think you can just keep screwing with us like this?

steps.name: Char Siu Member
steps.text: Now cut the crap and give us what's ours!

steps.name: Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: In your dreams! Let us see the boss first!

steps.name: Char Siu Member
steps.text: Taking us for a ride, are you? You want to go again?

steps.name: Lou Seoi Member
steps.text: Let's do it! I ain't afraid of you!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Okay, let's drop the weapons. If you got anything to say, say it at the station.

steps.name: Char Sius & Lou Seois
steps.text: Shit! It's a set-up!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: All of you, come with me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're the one who called this in, right?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yeah, that's me...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mind telling me how you found out a deal was going down between these two gangs?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Uh... It's a long story...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I'm still wrapping my head around it, but that's about the size of it... Do you believe me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hahaha, don't be so nervous. The L.G.D.'s actually been following this case for a while now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Guess there's no harm in telling you. Most of their weapon cache actually got strewn all over the streets after their last rumble. The L.G.D. tried to retrieve as much as we could, but the Char Sius still managed to get their hands on a decent chunk of what's left.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I-Isn't that dangerous?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yeah, though they didn't have the guts to smuggle the weapons themselves.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They were thinking of taking out the brand new Originium Devices on the weapons, and selling those instead. Of course, that's illegal too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The L.G.D. apprehended the Lou Seois' boss the other day. He was looking for a buyer for the stolen goods, you see.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: He's pretty tight-lipped. Couldn't get much out of him. We owe you a great deal tonight. It's all thanks to your plan that we managed to apprehend all these people.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Though come to think of it, you really shouldn't do anything so dangerous again.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: I see, so that's how it is...

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Um, ma'am? If there's nothing else, is it okay if I go now?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Truth be told, I've actually been keeping an eye on you too. With your skills, I think you're a bit overqualified to be a mere street hawker.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I know a much better gig for you. How about it?

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Well... I appreciate the offer, ma'am.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Though just as Lungmen needs police officers like you, it needs seafood hawkers like me too. It's not about qualifications.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Anyway, I don't think what I'm doing right now is so bad...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Haha, I get you. Of course, I'll respect your decision. If you ever have a change of heart, though, you know where to find me.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Thanks for your work. I'm gonna head back now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, and be sure to pay the L.G.D. a visit after the holidays for your certificate!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Oh, sure, when I have time.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Good kid. As expected from one of Tung's students. I knew I was right about him.
Several months later...
Hey, you see that finball stall there?
They're getting quite a lot of customers. Why don't we give it a try?
Hah, that's no normal finball stall. The stall's owner is actually the patriarch of the Lungmen Docks triads!
On New Year's Eve, he took on both the Char Sius and the Lou Seois all by himself, and you know what happened? He took down every last one! Also—
Shh! Quiet down. I think he heard that!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Yo, boss, how about some finballs?
